# What's the Best Way to Give Every Employee Record Vacation, Role, and History in One Place?


The best way is to build a unified employee profile connecting vacation balance, role details, and employment history as one relational record, instead of scattering that data across separate systems. On **Jestor** , this runs through **RH e Recrutamento** with a unified employee **table** .


Employee data scattered across a payroll system, a separate vacation tracker, and an informal notes document means no single view actually shows the complete picture of a given employee.


## What scattered employee data costs


- No single view combining an employee's vacation, role, and history together
- Time spent checking multiple systems to answer a straightforward HR question
- Risk of inconsistency between the different disconnected sources
- Difficulty onboarding a new HR team member to understand the full data landscape


## How a unified employee record works


- Vacation balance, role details, and employment **history** connect on one profile
- HR checks one record instead of piecing together multiple separate sources
- New HR team members can understand the complete picture from a single place
- Consistency improves since there's only one authoritative record per employee


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- The unified profile removes the need to check multiple disconnected systems
- A single authoritative source improves consistency across HR data
- Onboarding a new HR team member becomes simpler with one clear structure
- This scales from a small team to a company with a large, complex workforce


Scattered employee data Unified employee profile


Multiple sources to check One connected record


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can sensitive data, like salary, be restricted within the same record?** Yes, permissions can control field-level access to sensitive information. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this connect to payroll for compensation history?** It can connect to relevant financial systems, though payroll execution stays separate.


**Can employees see their own profile data?** Yes, depending on the self-service access configured for them.
